steps.sql: UPDATE valve_settings SET last_clock_sync_queued_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'); INSERT INTO valve_settings(device_eui,last_clock_sync_queued_at) SELECT deveui,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM devices WHERE type_id='STREGA_VALVE' AND deveui NOT IN (SELECT device_eui FROM valve_settings)

_comment: Dispatch round 4 client-construction sweep: a copy of 053-valve-frame-limits.json run with CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY empty on both sides. Record with OSI_ORACLE_NODE=edge/harness/scenarios/dispatch/oracle-nokey-node.sh and replay Go through a wrapper that runs `exec env CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY= <osi-edge> "$@"`. Covers schedule saves through the valve API: its lazy client rejects the queue read, so the flush intent is stored UNKNOWN with error chirpstack_transport_unavailable and the answer carries details.error.code transport_unavailable.
